decisions.TIME-06: Outside FOIMS-X time is real time; inside FOIMS-X at 1x one sim tick passes per 35 Doom tics.
decisions.TIME-07: Three FOIMS-X speed multipliers (1x, 2x, 3x), subject to change; not available outside FOIMS-X.
decisions.TIME-08: Player stat bands tick while in FOIMS-X, faster at higher speeds.
decisions.TIME-10: After a FOIMS-X ejection the player cannot re-enter until the stat is replenished.
decisions.TIME-15: No in-FOIMS-X pause control; Main Menu pause plus a debug-only pausefoimsx console command.
decisions.TIME-16: Time returns to real time after any exit or ejection.
decisions.TIME-19: Agent activities run in real time outside FOIMS-X.
